label: Vector index memory footprint
type: the memory and disk a vector index consumes - the resource quantity settings are traded against
note: Paired with vector-search:recall-rate as the two costs in the registry's vector tuning model. Object of tradesOffAgainst from vector-search:persist-full-vector: 'Storing the full vector significantly increases the size of the index.' Distinguish from memory:* , which is the Data Service's bucket and quota vocabulary, and from index:memory-optimized-storage, which is an Index Service storage mode and edition-gated.
